verdict.rationale: Deel documents first-party webhooks that deliver real-time notifications for key platform events, secured with HMAC-SHA256 signatures, so programmatic consumers can receive outbound callbacks. The evidence does not list which events are covered, so the payroll lifecycle events in the story are unconfirmed. Missing for 10: a documented event catalog covering payroll processed, employee onboarded and payment failed; subscription/registration mechanics; retry and delivery guarantees; independent or hands-on corroboration.
